cards.title: Rulings, now pinned by tests
items: 1. The pane reads down to the current task, always the last line; each level's other items fold into one line above the path item; in --follow only, lines are cut to the pane's width
2. The pane watches the files the tree reads (specs/, .sdlc/ config, findings and progress, docs/features/, the kit's two lists); git is not watched
3. The pane keeps each G0 verdict in memory, recomputed only when its contract or the vocabulary changes; nothing is written
4. A pane that starts on an approval notifies once: its first render counts as an arrival
5. The pane never waits on the notify command: it checks it each tick and prints the failure line on a nonzero exit

cards.title: Glossary
items: t7, t8: units of tree-view; t7 follows t3, t8 follows t7, and t9 (the release) waits on t8
Current task: derived from the progress records, never stored; the pane's last line
The seven tasks: approve the test list, write the tests, prove red, green, approve the commit, commit, Two-Key PASS
Spec channel: the agent that drafts the tests and proves red; the developer agent makes them green without opening tests/
Two-Key: a receipts agent re-runs every check, a zero-trust grader reads the commit against its sketches; the script computes the verdict
OPEN: a fact the contract cannot keep goes back to the REQUEST as a question and a re-intake, never a silent edit
